scripts.text: Your attack from before was a cheapshot! If you have something to do with the missing people around here, you won't be forgiven!
scripts.translation: 你刚才的攻击是偷袭！如果你和这里失踪的人有关，我绝不会原谅你！

scripts.text: Stop it. You cannot beat me.
Take your position. I won't take you by surprise!!!
scripts.translation: 摆好架势。我不会偷袭你的！！！

scripts.text: ... Yes, I think that I've been waiting for someone like you.
scripts.translation: ... 是的，我想我一直在等待像你这样的人。

scripts.text: I need brave adventurers, like you, to help me. Can you help me?
scripts.translation: 我需要像你这样勇敢的冒险者来帮我。你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: No, how can I trust you?
Hu.. you won't. But, I ask you again. Can you help me?
scripts.translation: 呼... 你拒绝了我。但我再问一次。你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: ... Ok, ok. There's no way I can refuse this type of request.
scripts.translation: ...好吧，好吧。这种请求我没法拒绝。

scripts.text: So, what do you want me to do?
This isn't a good place to talk. Get on my back, I will show you something.
scripts.translation: 这里不是说话的好地方。骑到我背上来，我带你去看样东西。

scripts.text: - He turns his back to me -
This is an adventurer from another land. He is not afraid of Koshei. He may be able to help you.
scripts.translation: 这是一位来自异乡的冒险者。他并不害怕科舍伊。也许他能帮到你。

scripts.text: Help me? Do you think he can stop Koshei?
scripts.translation: 帮我？你觉得他能阻止科舍伊吗？

scripts.text: Ah, hold on. Who is Koshei and who is talking?
scripts.translation: 啊，等一下。科舍伊是谁？还有，是谁在说话？

scripts.text: Koshei.. He is an immortal and endless evil. I fought against him a long tim ago. After a fierce fight, I had to seal him in the darkness because he is immortal.
scripts.translation: 科舍伊...他是永生不灭的邪恶。很久以前我曾与他战斗。经过一场激战，我不得不将他封印在黑暗中，因为他是不死的。

scripts.text: And as a result I became imprisoned in this wall.
scripts.translation: 结果我也被囚禁在这面墙里。

scripts.text: He has found a way to break away from his seal and I fear for the worst.
scripts.translation: 他找到了打破封印的方法，我担心最坏的情况会发生。

scripts.text: My name is Maria Morebna. Help me exterminate Koshei. I want to keep peace in Moscovia. Can you help me?
scripts.translation: 我叫玛丽亚·莫雷布娜。帮我消灭科舍伊。我想让莫斯科比亚保持和平。你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: So, how can I help you?
First, you need to find a way to get her out of there.
scripts.translation: 首先，你得想办法把她从墙里救出来。

scripts.text: I've heard about a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000' that can open anything. There is a keymaker in town.
scripts.translation: 我听说有一把^0000ff“黄金钥匙^000000”，能打开任何东西。镇上有位钥匙匠。

scripts.text: As you see, I look like a monster so I am not able to go there. I want you to find this keymaker and ask about the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
scripts.translation: 你也看到了，我看起来像魔物，所以我无法去那里。我想让你去找这位钥匙匠，问问关于^0000ff“黄金钥匙”^000000的事。

scripts.text: Help me get out of here.
scripts.translation: 帮我把我从这里弄出去。

scripts.text: I hope you can help me find that '^0000ffGolden Key^000000' that can open anything.
scripts.translation: 我希望你能帮我找到那把^0000ff能打开任何^000000东西的“黄金钥匙”。

scripts.text: I've heard about a keymaker in Moscovia who knows how to make a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
scripts.translation: 我听说莫斯科比亚有一位钥匙匠，他知道如何制^0000ff作“黄金钥^000000匙”。

scripts.text: ...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
...I need golden thread. I heard that I was able to get it from Marozka. He....
scripts.translation: ...我需要金线。我听说可以从马罗兹卡那里得到。他...

scripts.text: Marozka... He is the owner of winter and dwells in the deep underground. He won't let just anyone see him.
scripts.translation: 马罗兹卡...他是冬天的主人，居住在深深的地下。他不会让随便什么人见到他。

scripts.text: He has monsters that guard his underground lair. It's very dangerous. But, I know where he is.
scripts.translation: 他有魔物守卫着地下的巢穴。那里非常危险。但是，我知道他在哪里。

scripts.text: What do you think? I can open a portal to the cave Do you want to go there now?
scripts.translation: 你觉得怎么样？我可以打开一个通往洞穴的传送门。你想现在去那里吗？

scripts.text: ... When you're ready, just tell me.
scripts.translation: ...当你准备好的时候，告诉我一声。

scripts.text: ...Ok, be careful There are a lot of monsters there.
scripts.translation: ...好的，小心点。那里有很多魔物。

scripts.text: Not yet... Give me a second.
scripts.translation: 还没有...请给我一点时间。

scripts.text: If you gather all the necessary things, go to Moscovia and find the keymaker. Do me this favor, please.
scripts.translation: 如果你收集齐了所有必要的东西，就去莫斯科比亚找那位钥匙匠。请帮我这个忙。

scripts.text: I collected every meterial for the key, But have not yet got the key...
scripts.translation: 我收集齐了制作钥匙的所有材料，但还没有拿到钥匙...

scripts.text: Go to Moscovia and find the keymaker.
scripts.translation: 去莫斯科比亚找那位钥匙匠。

scripts.text: Not yet... Give me a second.
scripts.translation: 还没有...请给我一点时间。

scripts.text: If you gather all the things necessary, go to Moscovia and find the keymaker. Do me this favor, please.
scripts.translation: 如果你收集齐了所有必要的东西，就去莫斯科比亚找那位钥匙匠。请帮我这个忙。

scripts.text: I can feel Koshei's energy.. It is not a time to use the key...
scripts.translation: 我能感觉到科舍伊的能量...现在不是使用钥匙的时候...

scripts.text: I did. So, how do I use it?
scripts.translation: 我做到了。那么，我该怎么使用它？

scripts.text: Left the key up, and shout '^0000ffThe Free wind blows and gets you wherever you want^000000'.
scripts.translation: 举起钥匙，然后大喊^0000ff“自由的风会把你吹向任何你想去的地^000000方”。
- 一个非常年幼的女孩出现了 -

scripts.text: I'm finally out of there! Now I can.....................aaaaak!!!....
scripts.translation: 我终于出来了！现在我可以...啊啊啊——！...

scripts.text: I really want to thank you, human. Maria was imprisoned in the wall so I couldn't do anything!
scripts.translation: 我真想谢谢你，人类。玛丽亚被囚禁在墙里，我什么都做不了！

scripts.text: She'll thank me for giving her a quick death!!
scripts.translation: 她一定会感谢我给了她一个痛快的死法！！

scripts.text: But you, human... You are here to disturb me?
scripts.translation: 但是，人类...你是来打扰我的吗？

scripts.text: No one can stop me! Now, die!!!
scripts.translation: 没有人能阻止我！现在，去死吧！！！

scripts.text: You think you can fight me?!
Listen, I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
scripts.translation: 听着，如果我现在就治疗她，我还能救玛丽亚。

scripts.text: I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation: 我会带着她逃走，留你一个人去对付科舍伊！！

scripts.text: Stop! Where do you think you're going?!!!
scripts.translation: 站住！你以为你能逃到哪里去？！！！
我能感觉到科舍伊的存在。

scripts.text: I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
scripts.translation: 如果我现在就治疗她，我还能救玛丽亚。

scripts.text: I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation: 我会带着她逃走，留你一个人去对付科舍伊！！
但是，她的情况仍然不稳定。

scripts.text: To save her, I need 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'. Find Baba Yaga, she'll know what to do.
scripts.translation: 要救她，我需要“生命之水”和“死亡之水”。去找芭芭雅嘎，她会知道该怎么做。

scripts.text: I can't keep her alive for much longer. You must find Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation: 我撑不了太久了。你必须找到芭芭雅嘎。
但是，她的情况仍然不稳定。

scripts.text: To save her, I need 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'. Find Baba Yaga, she'll know what to do.
scripts.translation: 要救她，我需要“生命之水”和“死亡之水”。去找芭芭雅嘎，她会知道该怎么做。

scripts.text: I can't keep her alive for much longer. You must find Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation: 我撑不了太久了。你必须找到芭芭雅嘎。
我能感觉到科舍伊的存在。

scripts.text: I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
scripts.translation: 如果我现在就治疗她，我还能救玛丽亚。

scripts.text: I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation: 我会带着她逃走，留你一个人去对付科舍伊！！

scripts.text: Did you get the 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'?
scripts.translation: 你拿到“生命之水”和“死亡之水”了吗？
我拿到了！玛丽亚怎么样了？！

scripts.text: I fear that her spirit has gone. Severe wounds and curses are hindering her spirit from coming back. But we can save her with that water.
scripts.translation: 恐怕她的灵魂已经离开了。严重的伤势和诅咒阻碍了她的灵魂回归。但我们可以用那些水来救她。
- 倒在玛丽亚僵硬的身体上 -
- 倒在玛丽亚僵硬的身体上 -

scripts.text: What are you doing?! I told you we did not have much time! What are you going to do now?!
scripts.translation: 你在干什么？！我告诉过你时间不多了！你现在打算怎么办？！

scripts.text: I am so sorry. But some water is left...
scripts.translation: 非常抱歉。但还剩下一些水...

scripts.text: ...!? No, not 'Death Water'.. I should pour 'Life Water'.......
scripts.translation: ...！？不，不是“死亡之水”...应该倒入“生命之水”...

scripts.text: Hehehe, you can trust me. Next is the 'Life Water'.
scripts.translation: 呵呵呵，你可以信任我。接下来是“生命之水”。
- 我将“生命之水”倒在玛丽亚身上 -
好的，接下来是“生命之水”。
- 倒在玛丽亚僵硬的身体上 -

scripts.text: You saved me. I really appreicate it. Thank you for helping us fight against Koshei.
scripts.translation: 你救了我。我非常感激。谢谢你帮助我们对抗科舍伊。

scripts.text: And you, Gray Wolf.. Thank you for protecting me while I was helpless.
scripts.translation: 还有你，灰狼...谢谢你在我无助的时候保护我。

scripts.text: Koshei wasn't completely destroyed. But, his power has weakened, it shouldn't be hard to seal his power without me also being sealed.
scripts.translation: 科舍伊并没有被完全消灭。但他的力量已经减弱，即使没有我也应该不难封印他的力量。

scripts.text: Koshei and I are bound by magic. If one's power should be sealed, the other must be sealed as well.
scripts.translation: 科舍伊和我被魔法绑定在一起。如果一方的力量被封印，另一方也必须被封印。

scripts.text: But the original seal weakened over time and Koshei was able to get out of his confinement. That is why I asked you to get me out of here.
scripts.translation: 但最初的封印随着时间推移而减弱，科舍伊得以逃脱束缚。这就是为什么我让你把我救出来。

scripts.text: He realized that I was trying to break free and waited here for anyone who would help me. I never ever expected it...
scripts.translation: 他意识到我想挣脱束缚，便在这里等待任何会帮助我的人。我从未想到过这一点...

scripts.text: Anyway, I'm so grateful for everything you did.
scripts.translation: 总之，我非常感激你所做的一切。

scripts.text: Please accept my poor reward, I hope that it will be of some help for such a brave adventurer. I hope that the gods will bless you on your journey.
scripts.translation: 请收下我微薄的奖励，希望这对勇敢的冒险者有所帮助。愿众神保佑你的旅途。

scripts.text: It's been a long time since I've felt the sunlight, fresh wind and the scent of grass. I'm so grateful.
scripts.translation: 我已经很久没有感受到阳光、清新的微风和草地的芬芳了。我非常感激。

scripts.text: ... Koshei is immortal and will surely appear again someday...
scripts.translation: ...科舍伊是不死的，总有一天他一定会再次出现...

scripts.text: When that time comes, I will deal with him. I will use my time of waiting to train to make myself strong whenever he returns...
scripts.translation: 当那一天来临时，我会亲自解决他。我会利用等待的时间磨练自己，变得更强，无论他何时归来...

scripts.text: I'm grateful that you did your best for me and my village. I will never forget your kindness.
scripts.translation: 我很感激你为了我和村庄竭尽全力。我永远不会忘记你的善意。

scripts.text: Ah, Go to Baba Yaga in your free time. She seems to have something to tell you.
scripts.translation: 啊，有空的时候去找找芭芭雅嘎吧。她似乎有话要告诉你。

scripts.text: Take care of yourself. It is better for you to stay away from here because, Koshei may try to use your power as his own, huhu.
scripts.translation: 请保重。最好离这里远一点，因为科舍伊可能会试图利用你的力量为己用，呼呼。

scripts.text: Why are you carrying that much?
scripts.translation: 你为什么要带这么多东西？
是在为某件事做准备吗？

scripts.text: But, I've heard that some people have become lost in the forest on the island near this village. What's going on?
scripts.translation: 不过，我听说有些人在这座村庄附近岛屿的森林里迷路了。这是怎么回事？

scripts.text: But, I've heard that some people have become lost in the forest on the island near this village. What's going on?
scripts.translation: 不过，我听说有些人在这座村庄附近岛屿的森林里迷路了。这是怎么回事？

scripts.text: Excuse me, have you heard of a keymaker who knows how to make a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'?
scripts.translation: 打扰一下，你听说过会制作“黄金钥匙^0000ff”的钥匙匠^000000吗？

scripts.text: Hmm, are you an adventurer? Who told you about the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你是冒险者吗？是谁告诉你“黄^0000ff金钥匙”的^000000事的？

scripts.text: Well, then... The keymaker for the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
scripts.translation: 那么...关于“黄金^0000ff钥匙”的钥^000000匙匠。

scripts.text: You are very lucky to have asked me about this.
I'm the only one in this town that knows what materials are needed to make the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'! Bahaha!
scripts.translation: 我是这个镇上唯一知道制作“黄金钥匙”需要哪些^0000ff材料的人^000000！巴哈哈！

scripts.text: I guess you think that getting the materials will be easy huh?
scripts.translation: 我想你大概觉得收集材料很容易吧？

scripts.text: It will take a lot of work.
If you choose to take it.
scripts.translation: 前方将是一段漫长的旅程。
你的靴子会在旅途中磨破。

scripts.text: Of course! I have to help Maria!
scripts.translation: 当然！我必须帮助玛丽亚！

scripts.text: Ok, first, bring me ^0000ff25 Steel^000000. I'm not going anywhere so come back here when you have them.
scripts.translation: 好，首先，给^0000ff我带25^000000个钢铁来。我就在这里，拿到后回来找我。

scripts.text: Ok so that's the first thing you need for the 'Golden Key' right?
scripts.translation: 好的，所以这是制作“黄金钥匙”需要的第一个材料，对吧？

scripts.text: I promise you, I'll explain when you bring the ^0000ff25 Steel^000000 to me. Please just get the Steel and come back.
scripts.translation: 我向你保证，等你把25个钢铁^0000ff带给我时，^000000我会解释的。请先把钢铁找来再回来。

scripts.text: Ohhh, that was faster than I expected!

scripts.translation: 虽然不是我的得意之作，但够用了。

scripts.text: Bahaha~ Didn't I tell you? A long journey awaits you. These boots will help you on your long journey.
scripts.translation: 巴哈哈~ 我没告诉过你吗？前方将是一段漫长的旅程。这双靴子会在旅途中帮到你。

scripts.text: When they have worn out, you will know that your journey is near it's end.
scripts.translation: 当它们磨破时，你就知道旅程即将结束了。

scripts.text: ^ff0000You must always wear these boots while gathering the materials for the 'Golden Key'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000在收集制作“黄金钥匙”的材料时，你必须一直穿着这双靴^000000子。

scripts.text: Ok, I'll tell you what materials you need to get. I can make the key anytime if you get them to me.
scripts.translation: 好，我会告诉你需要哪些材料。只要你把它们带给我，我随时可以打造钥匙。

scripts.text: You need ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000 to make the key.
scripts.translation: 制作钥^0000ff匙需要2个诅咒红宝石、3个黄金、1个红戒指、2缕卢萨尔卡的^000000头发、10根金线。

scripts.text: Well, you know what to do now. I will be waiting here.
scripts.translation: 好了，你知道该做什么了。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text: And don't forget to wear these!
What are you doing? First, you must get me ^0000ff25 Steel^000000.
scripts.translation: 你在做什么？首先，你必须给我^0000ff带25个钢^000000铁来。

scripts.text: The faster you get me the materials, The faster you can help Maria Morebna.
scripts.translation: 你越快给我材料，就能越快帮助玛丽亚·莫雷布娜。

scripts.text: ...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
So, you got all the materials. I can't believe it.
scripts.translation: 所以，你集齐了所有材料。真不敢相信。

scripts.text: You did your best until your boots were worn out, didn't you?
scripts.translation: 你一直努力到靴子磨破为止，对吧？

scripts.text: Yes, you know, it's not very comfortable walking around in Steel boots all day!
scripts.translation: 是的，你知道的，整天穿着钢铁靴子走路并不舒服！
巴哈哈~ 好，干得不错。

scripts.text: Well.. While you were looking for the materials, I was searching for the keymaker who can make the key!
scripts.translation: 嗯... 在你寻找材料的时候，我也在寻找能打造这把钥匙的钥匙匠！

scripts.text: I thought you said that you knew how to make the key?
scripts.translation: 你不是说你知道怎么打造这把钥匙吗？

scripts.text: Hmm... Well I know the materials. And I know who makes the key. So I will tell you where to find the keymaker. Is that ok?
scripts.translation: 嗯... 好吧，我知道材料。我也知道谁打造这把钥匙。所以我会告诉你去哪里找钥匙匠。这样可以吗？

scripts.text: Of course! I have to know where this person is.
scripts.translation: 当然！我必须知道这个人在哪里。

scripts.text: Ok, listen carefully. The Keymaker is at a cabin deep inside of the forest.
scripts.translation: 好，仔细听。钥匙匠在森林深处的一间小屋里。

scripts.text: Ah, wait. Take off your armor. I need to cast a protection spell on you, ok? Hey, don't get the wrong idea. This is just a simple protection spell!
scripts.translation: 啊，等等。脱下你的盔甲。我需要给你施加一个保护咒语，好吗？嘿，别想歪了。这只是一个简单的保护咒语！

scripts.text: Bah ram y--- wait that's uh something else...
scripts.translation: 巴...拉姆... 等等，这...这是另一回事...

scripts.text: This spell protects you from any curse the keymaker might try to use. Remember the words of the spell. It won't last very long because I am just a blacksmith.
scripts.translation: 这个咒语可以保护你免受钥匙匠可能使用的任何诅咒。记住咒语的内容。它不会持续太久，因为我只是个铁匠。

scripts.text: The forest is dangerous. Be very careful in there!
scripts.translation: 森林很危险。在里面一定要非常小心！

scripts.text: The forest is dangerous. Be very careful in there!
scripts.translation: 森林很危险。在里面一定要非常小心！

scripts.text: Ah and you shouldn't be needing those Steel Boots anymore. Good luck!
scripts.translation: 森林很危险。在里面一定要非常小心！啊，而且你不再需要那些钢铁靴子了。祝你好运！

scripts.text: You need ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000 to make the key.
scripts.translation: 制作钥^0000ff匙需要2个诅咒红宝石、3个黄金、1个红戒指、2缕卢萨尔卡的^000000头发、10根金线。

scripts.text: The Red Ring has powerful enchanting powers. I had one before, but I gave it to my friend, Vassili, as a gift.
scripts.translation: 红戒指拥有强大的附魔力量。我以前有一个，但我把它作为礼物送给了我的朋友瓦西里。

scripts.text: I think it would be odd to ask him to give it back to me. So uh you've got to ask him if he would give it to you.
scripts.translation: 我觉得让他把它还给我有点奇怪。所以呃，你得问问他是否愿意把它给你。

scripts.text: It's said that a bride who drowns to death just before her wedding becomes Lusalka, the aqua fairy.
scripts.translation: 据说在婚礼前溺水而死的未婚妻会变成卢萨尔卡，水之妖精。
你必须找到卢萨尔卡的头发。

scripts.text: I heard that a young maid has been lost recently.
scripts.translation: 我听说最近有个年轻的女仆失踪了。

scripts.translation: 你没听说过卢萨尔卡的凝视能致人于死地吗。如果你没有带“圣水”，你肯定已经死了。

scripts.text: If so, you came here from another continent, not Moscovia...?
scripts.translation: 如果是这样，你是从其他大陆来的，而不是莫斯科比亚...？

scripts.text: A few days ago, my lover left for Rune-Midgarts.. Can you find him for me? I want to talk with him...
scripts.translation: 几天前，我的爱人去了卢恩·米德加兹。你能帮我找到他吗？我想和他谈谈...

scripts.text: ...I don't know why but, I can't remember how I became Lusalka. When I woke up, I was lying down on the bottom of the river.
scripts.translation: ...我不知道为什么，但我记不起我是怎么变成卢萨尔卡的。当我醒来时，我正躺在河底。

scripts.text: I forgot everything, but not him. His smile and warm hand. I remember everything about him.
scripts.translation: 我忘记了一切，除了他。他的笑容和温暖的手。关于他的一切我都记得。

scripts.text: I watched him from the bottom of the river sitting randomly around the river and staring into the marsh. With very sad eyes.
scripts.translation: 我从河底看着他，随意地坐在河边，凝视着沼泽。他的眼神非常悲伤。

scripts.text: I suffered seeing him grieve, but wasn't able to meet him. Ordinary people are killed immediately when they see Lusalka's stare...

scripts.text: I saw him coming to the marsh everyday and heard him mourning. And his assurance to go to Rune-Midgarts.

scripts.text: I became Lusalka, but it is ok. I'm not sad. But, I can feel his sadness around this river that surrounds me. I feel sorry about it.
scripts.translation: 我变成了卢萨尔卡，但这没关系。我不悲伤。但我能感觉到围绕着我的这条河流中，他的悲伤。这让我感到难过。

scripts.text: Please, find him and tell him that I am ok and to stop suffering...
scripts.translation: 请找到他，告诉他我很好，让他停止痛苦...

scripts.text: The night when he left, he said that he would go to the capital of Rune-Midgarts. I am not sure if he is still there...

scripts.text: I met her by accident. She became Lusalka in the marsh of Moscovia.
scripts.translation: 我偶然遇见了她。她在莫斯科比亚的沼泽里变成了卢萨尔卡。

scripts.text: She told me that you wouldn't believe me so she gave me these earrings as proof... The present that you gave to her.
scripts.translation: 她说你不会相信我，所以给了我这对耳环作为证明...那是你送给她的礼物。
她真的变成了卢萨尔卡？

scripts.text: It was near the end of the harsh Moscovia winter... She... didn't realize that the ice on the marsh was already melting...
scripts.translation: 那是莫斯科比亚严冬的末尾...她...没有意识到沼泽上的冰已经开始融化了...

scripts.text: By then, it was too late the ice cracked where she was and she fell into the freezing cold marsh.
scripts.translation: 等到发现时已经太迟了，她脚下的冰裂开了，她掉进了冰冷刺骨的沼泽里。

scripts.text: She wasn't able to swim. I tried to get her out but it was impossible.
scripts.translation: 她不会游泳。我试图把她拉上来，但根本做不到。

scripts.text: She sunk quickly into the marsh. I was able to reach her hand but, she realized that it would kill both of us and she released my hand... I regret that moment every single day.
scripts.translation: 她迅速沉入了沼泽。我抓住了她的手，但她意识到这样会害死我们两个人，于是松开了手...我每天都在为那一刻感到后悔。

scripts.text: My last memory of her was of her smiling, as she sunk into the cold, wet marsh. As if to say, 'You will be ok.'
scripts.translation: 我对她最后的记忆，是她微笑着沉入冰冷潮湿的沼泽。仿佛在说：“你会没事的。”

scripts.text: I, I was a coward. I was too afraid of drowning to pull her out of the marsh. Too afraid of....
scripts.translation: 我...我是个懦夫。我太害怕溺水了，不敢把她从沼泽里拉上来。太害怕...了...

scripts.text: ...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
I knew that she had become the cursed nymph Lusalka. But, I still went every night... to find her. I just wanted to see her and talk to her.
scripts.translation: 我知道她变成了被诅咒的精灵卢萨尔卡。但我还是每晚都去...寻找她。我只是想看看她，和她说话。

scripts.text: She told me that she also wanted to see you. But, she was afraid that Lusalka's curse would kill you if you saw her.
scripts.translation: 她说她也想见你。但她害怕卢萨尔卡的诅咒会在你看到她时夺走你的性命。

scripts.text: How could she think of me...
Don't be sad. She still loves you. Your suffering is her suffering.
scripts.translation: 别难过。她依然爱着你。你的痛苦就是她的痛苦。
...她真的吗？谢谢你。你给了我鼓励。

scripts.text: I will go back to Moscovia. But, I'm not well enough at the moment to go back.
scripts.translation: 我会回到莫斯科比亚的。但我现在的状态还不够好，无法立刻回去。

scripts.text: Could you please go to her and tell her my message?
scripts.translation: 请你去见她，把我的话告诉她好吗？

scripts.text: I remember every moment I've had with her and... I still love her.
scripts.translation: 我记得和她在一起的每一个瞬间...我依然爱着她。

scripts.text: Before the full moon, I will be back to Moscovia and meet her. I will come back so strong and happy that when I go to see her she will not suffer anymore.
scripts.translation: 在满月之前，我会回到莫斯科比亚见她。我会变得足够强大和快乐，这样当我去见她时，她就不会再受苦了。

scripts.text: Could you please go to her and tell her my message?
scripts.translation: 请你去见她，把我的话告诉她好吗？

scripts.text: I remember every moment I've had with her and... I still love her.
scripts.translation: 我记得和她在一起的每一个瞬间...我依然爱着她。

scripts.text: Before the full moon, I will be back to Moscovia and meet her. I will come back so strong and happy that when I go to see her she will not suffer anymore.
scripts.translation: 在满月之前，我会回到莫斯科比亚见她。我会变得足够强大和快乐，这样当我去见她时，她就不会再受苦了。

scripts.text: ... I feel like I lost something precious.
scripts.translation: ...我感觉自己失去了什么珍贵的东西。

scripts.text: - He looks down at the golden earrings and rubs it carefully -
scripts.translation: - 他低头看着那对金耳环，小心翼翼地擦拭着 -

scripts.text: Who dares to come into my cave!
Are you Marozka? Maria sent me! I need your 'Golden Thread' to make a 'Golden Key' to release her from the wall!
scripts.translation: 你是马罗兹卡吗？玛丽亚派我来的！我需要你的“金线”来做一把“黄金钥匙”，把她从墙里救出来！

scripts.text: Do you think that you are right for this job?
scripts.translation: 你以为自己适合做这件事吗？

scripts.text: You must be fighting against 'Koshei' if you are asking about the 'Golden Key' and Maria! Do you think that you are strong enough to fight against him?
scripts.translation: 既然你在打听“黄金钥匙”和玛丽亚，那你一定是在对抗“科舍伊”！你以为自己有足够的实力与他战斗吗？

scripts.text: But, I need to test you to see if you truly are capable.
scripts.translation: 但我需要测试你，看看你是否真的有能力。

scripts.text: In this cave, there is a 'Stone Furnace' and an 'Apple Tree'.
scripts.translation: 在这个洞穴里，有一个“石炉”和一棵“苹果树”。

scripts.text: You can escape from the cave with ^0000ff100 Well Baked Cookies^000000 from the Stone Furnace and ^0000ff100 Apples^000000 from the Apple Tree.
scripts.translation: 你可以用石炉里的^0000ff100烤好的^000000饼干和苹果树上的^0000ff100苹^000000果离开洞穴。

scripts.text: It won't be easy. Monsters are wandering around the Stone Furnace and the Apple Tree.
scripts.translation: 这不会容易。魔物在石炉和苹果树周围游荡。

scripts.text: Show me what you can do.
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
How did this rat get inside the cave?!
scripts.translation: 这只老鼠是怎么钻进洞穴里的？！

scripts.text: ...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
Are you Marozka? Here, I've proven to you my strength now can you make me the 'Golden Thread'?
scripts.translation: 你是马罗兹卡吗？我已经向你证明了我的实力，现在你能给我制作“金线”吗？

scripts.text: I need it to get Maria out of that wall.
scripts.translation: 我需要它来把玛丽亚从墙里救出来。

scripts.text: As you've heard, to make the 'Golden Thread' is very difficult and takes a very long time.
scripts.translation: 正如你所知，制作“金线”非常困难，而且需要很长的时间。

scripts.text: I will begin making it now... let me see... Could you please come back to me in an hour?
scripts.translation: 我现在就开始制作...让我看看...你能在一小时后回来找我吗？

scripts.text: I have finally finished making the 'Golden Thread'. Just wait one more second and it'll be ready.
scripts.translation: 我终于完成了“金线”的制作。再等一秒，它就准备好了。

scripts.text: As you've heard, to make the 'Golden Thread' is very difficult and takes a very long time.
scripts.translation: 正如你所知，制作“金线”非常困难，而且需要很长的时间。

scripts.text: I will begin making it now... let me see... Could you please come back to me in an hour?
scripts.translation: 我现在就开始制作...让我看看...你能在一小时后回来找我吗？

scripts.text: So, you are really going to fight Koshei the Immportal, eh?
scripts.translation: 所以，你真的要去挑战不死者科舍伊吗？

scripts.text: I don't know but I promised to get Maria out of there.
scripts.translation: 我不知道，但我答应过要把玛丽亚从那里救出来。

scripts.text: Huh, Koshei is not your average adversary. Strength alone cannot beat him. You will need wisdom and an unfaltering spirit in order to win.
scripts.translation: 科舍伊可不是普通的对手。仅凭力量是无法战胜他的。你需要智慧和坚定的意志才能获胜。

scripts.text: Koshei will be extremely hostile to you because you are helping Maria.
scripts.translation: 因为你帮助了玛丽亚，科舍伊会对你极度敌视。

scripts.text: Do you still want the Golden Thread? Ok, I will give it to you! But, there is one more test.
scripts.translation: 你还要金线吗？好吧，我会给你的！但是，还有一个考验。

scripts.text: Didn't I already prove my worth?
scripts.translation: 我不是已经证明了自己的价值吗？

scripts.text: That was a test of your strength. Now you must pass the test of mind and wisdom.
scripts.translation: 那是对你力量的考验。现在，你必须通过智慧和心智的考验。

scripts.text: ...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
Ok then. Come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation: 好吧。等你准备好了再回来。

scripts.text: You will... Ok, let's get to it. You must answer all of these questions correctly in order to pass the test.
scripts.translation: 你会...好吧，让我们开始吧。你必须正确回答所有这些问题才能通过考验。

scripts.text: What is deaf, dumb, and blind and always tells the truth?
scripts.translation: 什么东西是聋的、哑的、瞎的，却总是说真话？

scripts.text: If 4 cats can catch 4 mice every 4 minutes, what is the minimum number of cats needed to get 10 mice in 10 minutes?
scripts.translation: 如果4只猫每4分钟能抓4只老鼠，那么要在10分钟内抓10只老鼠，最少需要几只猫？

scripts.text: Which of these gets shorter during winter and longer during summer?
scripts.translation: 下列哪样东西在冬天会变短，在夏天会变长？

scripts.text: Doris Etticoat, wears a petticoat and has a red nose; the longer she stands, the shorter she grows. What is she?
scripts.translation: 多丽丝·艾提科特，穿着衬裙，有着红色的鼻子；她站得越久，身体就越短。她是什么？

scripts.text: My top and bottom are twins of a kind. The middle of me makes one body combined. If I stand tall and still, run faster I will. What am I?
scripts.translation: 我上下两端是一对双胞胎，中间把它们连成一个整体。我站直不动时，便能跑得更快。我是什么？

scripts.text: Now let's see how you did.
scripts.translation: 现在来看看你的表现吧。

scripts.text: You got all of them correct.
I told you before that I wouldn't give you the Golden Thread until you got all questions correct.
scripts.translation: 我之前说过，除非你答对所有问题，否则我不会把金线给你。

scripts.text: It is not too late to try again. With wisdom comes patience.
scripts.translation: 现在再试一次也不晚。智慧伴随着耐心。

scripts.text: I know that a quiz is a strange way of evaluating a person's wisdom. But, it is my way of knowing if you are truly committed to fighting Koshei.
scripts.translation: 我知道用问答来评判一个人的智慧有些奇怪。但这是我确认你是否真的下定决心要对抗科舍伊的方式。

scripts.text: I hope you help Maria with your strength and kindness.
scripts.translation: 希望你能用你的力量和善良去帮助玛丽亚。

scripts.text: If you lotter around here any longer, I will make myself some tasty human soup! Hehehehehe.
scripts.translation: 你要是再在这里闲逛，我就给自己煮一锅美味的人肉汤！嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text: Why are you here, you yummy looking human? If you lotter around here any longer, I will make myself some tasty human soup! Hehehehehe
scripts.translation: 你这个看起来很美味的人类，为什么在这里？要是再在这里闲逛，我就给自己煮一锅美味的人肉汤！嘿嘿嘿嘿

scripts.text: Do you want me to transform you into a savage beast?!
scripts.translation: 要不要我把你变成一只野兽？！

scripts.text: Hmm? You are protected by a Protection Spell?
But, it was weake. My spell destroyed it.
scripts.translation: 不过这咒语太弱了，已经被我破除了。

scripts.text: Leave now, or I will curse you again! 'Presto...'
scripts.translation: 现在离开，否则我会再次诅咒你！“变变变...”

scripts.text: Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...
Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...
Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...
What are you planning to do with that weak spell!?
scripts.translation: 你打算用那个弱小的咒语做什么？！

scripts.text: Ho, you are protected by a Protection Spell. You are no ordinary kid.
scripts.translation: 哦，你被保护咒语保护着。你不是普通的小孩。

scripts.text: I heard that you are able to make the 'Golden Key' and that's why I am here!
scripts.translation: 我听说你能制作“黄金钥匙”，所以我才来到这里！

scripts.text: 'Golden Key'? Why do you need it?
I need it to release Maria Mobrena from her dark wall prison.
scripts.translation: 我需要它来释放玛丽亚·莫雷布娜，把她从黑暗之墙中解救出来。

scripts.text: If he gets in my way of keeping my promise to her, I guess that I will fight him.
scripts.translation: 如果他阻碍我履行对她的承诺，我想我会和他战斗。
呵呵，嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text: You are interesting. You don't seem to be scared of Koshei.
scripts.translation: 你很有趣。你似乎并不害怕科舍伊。

scripts.text: Ok, the materials for the key are...
scripts.translation: 好吧，制作钥匙的材料是...

scripts.text: You have already gatered all the materials?
scripts.translation: 你已经收集齐所有材料了吗？

scripts.text: What? I cannot make you the 'Golden Key' without the materials.
scripts.translation: 什么？没有材料，我无法为你制作“黄金钥匙”。

scripts.text: Go and find ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000!
scripts.translation: 去收集2个^0000ff诅咒红宝石、3个黄金、1个红戒指、2缕卢萨尔卡的头发、10根^000000金线！

scripts.text: Ok, let's begin. Ah, before that... Wait here!
scripts.translation: 好吧，让我们开始吧。啊，在那之前...站在这里别动！

scripts.text: Hmmm, you look energetic and strong. Ok, while I make the 'Golden Key', you must first do a favor for me!
scripts.translation: 嗯，你看起来精力充沛且强壮。好吧，在我制作“黄金钥匙”的时候，你必须先帮我一个忙！

scripts.translation: 好！快走，快走！你最好快点，否则我会想办法惩罚你的。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.translation: 嘿，你买到魔法书了吗？给我。我要试试。

scripts.translation: 呵...这是为了美丽的花园。这比我预期的要好。那么，让我们开始吧。

scripts.text: Hey, are you listening to me?
'There is an order for you to open your eyes!!!'
Hmm, this one makes people deligent and doesn't look effective. Ok then, next is a House Ghost...

scripts.translation: 怎么了，孩子？你感觉不舒服吗？

scripts.text: I have done your favor! I got the cow!
scripts.translation: 我帮你办好了！我抓住了奶牛！
